# BYZIST — Istanbul Experiences

> Private guided tours of Istanbul's Old City with licensed tourist guide Ergin Karakoyun — 32 years of experience. Official tours in 4 languages: Turkish, English, Chinese and German. Skip-the-line tickets, private groups, book direct with a 25% deposit and WhatsApp confirmation.

## Pages

- [Home (English)](https://www.byzist.com/en): all tours, prices and booking
- [Your guide — Ergin Karakoyun](https://www.byzist.com/en/guide): biography, documentaries and TV appearances
- [Booking](https://www.byzist.com/en/booking): build your booking and pay the deposit
- Other languages: [Deutsch](https://www.byzist.com/de) · [中文](https://www.byzist.com/zh) · [Türkçe](https://www.byzist.com/tr)

## Tours

- [Hagia Sophia](https://www.byzist.com/en/tours/hagia-sophia): private guided visit with an optional skip-the-line ticket
- [Topkapi Palace](https://www.byzist.com/en/tours/topkapi-palace): private guided tour of the palace and the Harem
- [Topkapi Palace Night Tour](https://www.byzist.com/en/tours/topkapi-night): seasonal night opening, June to September. Night museum visits at Topkapi Palace began on 29 June 2024 (Presidency of National Palaces); Ergin has led this tour since its first season in 2024
- [Sultanahmet & Hippodrome](https://www.byzist.com/en/tours/sultanahmet-hippodrome): Blue Mosque, Hippodrome and the Old City squares
- [Basilica Cistern](https://www.byzist.com/en/tours/basilica-cistern): the underground cistern and its Medusa heads
- [Grand Bazaar & Spice Bazaar](https://www.byzist.com/en/tours/bazaars-tour): the two historic bazaars in one tour
- [Private Bosphorus Yacht Tour](https://www.byzist.com/en/tours/bosphorus-yacht): 2 hours on the water between two continents, private group of up to 8 guests
- [Full-Day Istanbul](https://www.byzist.com/en/tours/full-day-istanbul): the Old City highlights in one day
- [Half-Day Istanbul](https://www.byzist.com/en/tours/half-day-istanbul): 3 hours, the Old City essentials
- [Traditional Handicrafts](https://www.byzist.com/en/tours/traditional-handicrafts): free presentation — carpets, Iznik tiles and pottery, Turkish coffee and tea

## Good to know

- Meeting point for Old City tours: in front of the Four Seasons Hotel, Sultanahmet.
- Ergin Karakoyun is a licensed professional tourist guide and a founding delegate of the Chamber of Turkey Guides. He appears in episode 7 of TRT tabii's series "Like a Dream: Istanbul".
- Ratings: TripAdvisor 4.7/5 (58 reviews), Viator Badge of Excellence, Airbnb 4.86 (36 reviews).
- Legal operator: Oligarch Tour, TÜRSAB document no. 14988.
